instruction.name: vstelm.h
instruction.description: Store element `lane` of `data` to memory address `addr + offset`. Address misalignment does not raise an exception. The `offset` operand is a byte offset; the encoded instruction stores it as a scaled immediate for wider elements.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vstelm.h $vr0, $r20, 0, 0; vstelm.h $vr1, $r20, 2, 0; vstelm.h $vr2, $r20, 4, 0; vstelm.h $vr3, $r20, 6, 0; vstelm.h $vr4, $r20, 8, 0; vstelm.h $vr5, $r20, 10, 0; vstelm.h $vr6, $r20, 12, 0; vstelm.h $vr7, $r20, 14, 0
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; vreplgr2vr.b $vr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; vreplgr2vr.b $vr3, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; vreplgr2vr.b $vr4, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; vreplgr2vr.b $vr5, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; vreplgr2vr.b $vr6, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; vreplgr2vr.b $vr7, $r4; addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; vreplgr2vr.b $vr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; vreplgr2vr.b $vr3, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; vreplgr2vr.b $vr4, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; vreplgr2vr.b $vr5, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; vreplgr2vr.b $vr6, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; vreplgr2vr.b $vr7, $r4; addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r4' --asm 'vstelm.h $vr0, $r20, 0, 0; vstelm.h $vr1, $r20, 2, 0; vstelm.h $vr2, $r20, 4, 0; vstelm.h $vr3, $r20, 6, 0; vstelm.h $vr4, $r20, 8, 0; vstelm.h $vr5, $r20, 10, 0; vstelm.h $vr6, $r20, 12, 0; vstelm.h $vr7, $r20, 14, 0'
throughput.notes: 8 independent memory operations take 4.01 cycles. Buffer is 64-byte aligned; unaligned LASX loads/stores are substantially slower. The measured CPI 0.5012 is the nominal 0.5 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: Vector memory operation. Throughput measured with a hot, 64-byte-aligned 1KB stack buffer; latency not measured because it depends on cache/coherence state and needs a separate dependency chain.
